note: HBL's schedule of bank charges (effective 1 July to 31 December 2026, before federal excise duty and sales tax, whose rate the schedule doesn't state): the HBL Green Card's annual fee is 6,500 rupees, and its service charges are at most 42% a year on the outstanding amount.

sources.title: HBL, Schedule of Bank Charges (July to December 2026)
sources.said: SCHEDULE OF BANK CHARGES (Exclusive of FED/ST) Effective from July 01, 2026 to December 31, 2026 ... HBL Credit Cards HBL CreditCard HBL FuelSaver ... Service Charges Maximum 42% Maximum 42% ... Annual Fee Rs. 6,500/- for HBL Green Card
